ns2:section.sectionText: Students must register for the online section AN1 and one lab section. If seats are available: Course may open to sophomores in News Editorial Journalism and AGCM at 8:30am on April 15th.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Agr & Environmental Cmc & Educ or News-Editorial or Broadcast Journalism or Agricultural Communications major(s). Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
